sources.title: Hundreds of taxi drivers protest in Rīga Monday

sources.provenance: LSM English / Latvian Public Media, directly opened; reports the Rīga convoy, around 200 cars, and planned rallies. Protesters opposed Bolt platform policies and demanded action against market concentration.

provisional_leads.assessment: Strongly dated and described labor/economic protest, with same-day observation by public media and a later follow-up.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Same-day article’s detailed convoy description focuses on Rīga; May follow-up confirms actions in Daugavpils and Jelgava but exact turnout by city was not established.
